Putin claims election turnout shows support for Ukraine military agenda

Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the record turnout in the parliamentary election demonstrates public backing for his government's policies, including its military actions in Ukraine. Preliminary results show United Russia winning a substantial majority in the Duma. The election incorporated voting in Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia, a move not recognized by Ukraine.
